entries.headline: Dammam air-traffic disruption claim relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an OSINTWarfare report of air-traffic disruptions over Dammam and an apparent Ansar Allah attack on King Fahd International Airport, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: US cargo and tanker aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. military cargo and refuelling aircraft airborne over the continental United States and the Middle East, including at least five tankers near the Persian Gulf.

entries.headline: VC-25A with hex ADFDF9 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing VC-25A with no callsign, hex ADFDF9 and registration 92-9000, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Ege Şanda via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Reported PJAK attacks in Kermanshah relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that the Iranian Kurdish separatist group PJAK was attacking several towns in Kermanshah Province, western Iran, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: KC-46A activity south of Kish Island reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force Boeing KC-46A Pegasus, registration 11-46059 and hex AE5FA6, from Al Udeid, Qatar, and described its operation as 50 kilometres south of Kish Island, Iran, citing alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: C-5M RCH2080 spotted from Burgas
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force Lockheed C-5M Super Galaxy using callsign RCH2080, registration 86-0011 and hex AE0568, with Burgas, Bulgaria shown as its origin and the destination as N/A.

entries.headline: C-17A with hex AE07F6 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing C-17A Globemaster III using callsign X and hex AE07F6, citing a sighting by TruthSeekr60 and a photo by zgh.spotter via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: US military aircraft and two coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft active over the continental United States alongside surveillance aircraft, and said two coded radio broadcasts were heard during the hour.

entries.headline: EAM header 56DAEW reported
entries.summary: War Watch posted an EAM header and preamble report with header code 56DAEW and a displayed time of 12:07 ZULU.

entries.headline: EAM header 56NGQI reported
entries.summary: War Watch posted an EAM header and preamble report with header code 56NGQI and a displayed time of 11:58 AM.

entries.headline: E-3C Sentry with hex AE11EA spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-3C Sentry with no callsign, hex AE11EA and registration 80-0137, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by STR042 via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: C-32A VENUS62 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing C-32A using callsign VENUS62, hex ADFEB7 and registration 98-0001, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Donald e Moore via Planespotters.net.
